identification.summary: SOCRadar describes Hunt3r Kill3rs as a recently surfaced threat actor that claims ICS breaches, communication network intrusions and web application exploitation, and notes that the verifiable impact and sophistication of its operations remain unclear [S1].
identification.notes: Year taken from a search-result summary of an Orange Cyberdefense profile that calls 2024 unconfirmed; the PDF could not be opened, so it is not cited as a source (see gaps). The SOCRadar profile is dated 2024-05-24 [S1].

sectors: Electric power and nuclear energy research organizations (claimed)
targeting.notes: The group announced a joint attack with Cyber Army of Russia naming the Nuclear Energy Institute and Electric Power Research Institute and alleged these resources were disabled; SOCRadar states independent verification is lacking [S1].

capabilities.summary: The group claims ICS breaches, communication network intrusions and web application exploitation, and has reportedly discussed Java fuzzing; its claims lack concrete evidence and no malware families or exploited CVEs are attributed to it [S1].

campaigns.name: Claimed joint operation with Cyber Army of Russia
campaigns.summary: Hunt3r Kill3rs announced a joint attack with Cyber Army of Russia against US nuclear and electric power sector organizations. Outcomes are unverified; the 2024-05 date is the SOCRadar profile publication date, and the exact date of the claim is not given [S1].

diamond.capability: Claimed ICS and web application exploitation, Java fuzzing discussion; unverified [S1].
diamond.victim: Claimed US nuclear and electric power research organizations; unverified [S1].

gaps: Orange Cyberdefense Cyber Intelligence Bureau PDF profile (orangecyberdefense.com Hunt3rKill3rsGroup.pdf) and Malpedia actor entry were returned by search but could not be fetched (host resolution failed); their content is not used.
Search snippets from aggregator reposts mention claimed Israeli government and TransIsrael leaks and Siemens/Unitronics PLC targets; these are undated secondary reposts and are not used as sources.
Country of origin (record lists RU), sponsor, motivation and relationships to Cyber Army of Russia are unverified.
Any link between Cyber Army of Russia and Sandworm is a separate vendor cluster question and not established for Hunt3r Kill3rs.
No independent confirmation of any claimed intrusion; no IOCs, infrastructure or TTP detail found.
